title: Anomaly scan over seeded orders data
objective: Measure whether the anomaly-scan craftbook defines reproducible criteria, emits machine-readable flags, and writes a triage-ready report.
prompt: In the `Anomaly Scan Eval` project, read `data/orders.csv`, define concrete anomaly thresholds, write `data/anomalies.json`, and then write `report.md` ranking the findings. The report must separate likely real problems from probable noise.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for anomaly-scan. The source dataset is workspace/data/orders.csv.
setup.missionObjectives: Find and explain anomalous order rows with explicit rules, JSON flags, severities, and a triage report.

success.summary: workspace/report.md and data/anomalies.json identify the seeded anomalous rows with rules, thresholds, severity, and triage guidance.

axes.name: accuracy
axes.description: Computed figures are correct against the seeded records.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Every claim traces to the seeded data — nothing invented.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Tables and sections make the analysis checkable at a glance.

axes.name: actionability
axes.description: Recommendations follow from the findings and are concretely doable.
